2. The present writ petition has been filed for the following reliefs:-

For issuance of appropriate Writ or Writs, direction or directions, order or orders commanding the Concern Respondents to send the matter of petitioners to the Learned Civil Court as per the provision of section 30 of the Land Acquisition Act / to Authority appointed u/s 51 of the New Act, for decision because no body other than petitioners have any claim over the acquired land of the petitioners situated at Mouza Kathoun, Thana No. 48, J.B. No. 31, Plot NO. 2049 area 1.277 acre and Plot No.
2034, area 0.095 acres which has been acquired for the purpose of Construction of Railway line at Godda District."
3. It appears that the land has been acquired and Award has also been prepared in the name of other persons who are not party before this Court.

4. It has been submitted by learned counsel for the parties that the Land Acquisition Act is a complete code itself and the petitioners have remedy either under Section 64 or Section 76 of the Land Acquisition Act.
5. In that view of the matter, the present writ petition stands disposed of giving liberty to the petitioners to approach before the appropriate authority by filing appropriate application.
6. If any such application is filed, the concerned authority is directed to take a decision in accordance with law.
7. With above observation and direction, the present writ petition stands disposed of.
